description: Find Park Graph parking lots near a place, nearest first, with spaces left and the current rate. No API key needed. Ask the driver where they're going and work out its latitude and longitude first. Each lot's id is what quote, get_lot and reserve take. The top-level summary is a one-line answer you can quote. An empty list means Park Graph has no lots near that point: say so, and never make up lots.

lat.description: Latitude of where the driver is going, worked out from the place or address they give

lng.description: Longitude of where the driver is going

radius_km.description: How far from that point to look, in km

name: search_lots
title: Search parking lots
